川普介入與董事會態度大逆轉

令人困惑的是，董事會在黃仁勳於11月12日辭職後原本態度極為強硬，甚至公開表態絕無復職計劃。然而，短短數天內情勢急遽變化。除了矽谷發起超過18萬人簽署的「聲援黃仁勳」（Stand with Jensen）連署之外，關鍵推手正是美國總統川普。在司法部確認黃仁勳並無違法事證後，川普動員了副總統、財政部長及商務部長全力遊說董事會。川普更透露，在與中國領導人會晤後，擔憂若美國處置過當會導致黃仁勳被中國挖角，加上輝達股價大跌的現實壓力，最終促成董事會一致同意迎回黃仁勳。

Originally, the NVIDIA board's stance was very tough, saying Jensen had to go . Why the sudden change? And they were even in unanimous agreement. According to reports from the New York Times and The Wall Street Journal, this past weekend was critical. After Trump learned from the Department. of Justice that there was no evidence of wrongdoing by Jensen, he began a full-scale lobbying effort toward the NVIDIA board. In an exclusive interview with CNBC, Trump mentioned that he not only communicated directly and indirectly with the board but also brought in the Vice President, Treasury Secretary, and Commerce Secretary to mediate. He also said that if he had made the call a few days earlier, it might not have been so easy to convince the board, but seeing NVIDIA's stock price plummet made things much easier. As for the board's biggest concern regarding national security, the Trump administration gave them full assurances.

. He believes Jensen won't affect national security, though he didn't rule it out entirely and made no explicit promise that Jensen wouldn't be prosecuted. However, what Trump is truly worried about isn't just the stock market. He said that while attending the APEC summit in China last week, he spent quite some time talking about Jensen Huang with Xi Jinping. Although Xi Jinping didn't know much about Jensen Huang, he praised him as very intelligent, which made him worry that if the U.S. treated Huang too poorly, China might just poach him to run Huawei or something similar. But when reporters pressed him on whether there was any. indication that China actually intended to poach him, Trump admitted there was none at all; in his view, however, letting Jensen Huang continue to lead NVIDIA is not a national security risk. Losing Jensen Huang would be, but doesn't a U.S. President intervening directly in a public company's personnel decisions have any boundaries? If it were AI giants like Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, or Anthropic in trouble today, would Trump jump in to intervene as well ? Trump actually brought up his favorite pastime, golf, saying it’s just like the game—it requires touch and feel to get. the ball to the right spot, meaning the government’s interference in private business is entirely situational. The board has also established a National Security and Export Control.

Committee, bringing in experts to ensure the company follows trade regulations and avoids crossing national security red lines; additionally, a Chief Compliance Officer position has been created to oversee company-wide adherence and report directly to the board's governance committee. This means that although Jensen Huang has regained his position, he will face much stricter oversight from the board upon his return. Finally, there is the congressional investigation. Jensen Huang is scheduled to face a closed-door questioning by three joint House committees on December 1st, followed by Nvidia’s Chief Legal Officer the next day. Both sessions will have transcripts, and on December 3rd,.

Huang is set to appear before the Senate . During the Banking Committee’s public hearing—an investigative hearing regarding alleged illegal activities or misconduct—the atmosphere is usually at its most tense, with lawmakers often relentlessly demanding that the individual involved provide clear answers. At this point, you might wonder : Nvidia is a private company, does the U.S. Congress really have that much power? Actually, it is quite significant . The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that investigations are an indispensable part of Congress exercising its legislative. power, because how can Congress draft effective laws if it doesn’t even know where the problems lie? As long as there is a legitimate legislative purpose and it falls within a committee's jurisdiction, congressional investigative power is quite broad. Not only can they demand answers, internal documents, emails, and meeting minutes, but they can also issue subpoenas when necessary to compel relevant individuals to testify. If one refuses to cooperate without cause, Congress can even seek court enforcement or refer the case to the Department of Justice to pursue contempt of Congress charges. Furthermore, the targets of. congressional investigations are not just private companies; even the White House and executive departments cannot hide. In other words, even if Trump personally endorses Jensen Huang, Congress still has the right to demand that the government explain exactly what information it based its judgment on to determine that Huang poses no national security risk. Of course, the President can claim executive privilege and refuse to disclose certain internal decision-making information, but this privilege is not absolute; if necessary , it can lead to litigation, with courts intervening to resolve the matter.

So, even with Trump’s endorsement, Congress will investigate what it needs to. Whether Jensen Huang can truly emerge unscathed remains to be seen. Everything discussed so far concerns the operations of the company, the board, and the White House, but can Jensen Huang’s family simply let go of his affair? In the final sentence of Huang’s statement, he says, "I am grateful for the love and support of my family." It is worth noting that he expresses gratitude to his family without offering further apologies for the affair. Does this mean he has secured their. forgiveness? The most important factor, of course, is the attitude of his wife, Lori. So, has she forgiven him? You should know that these tech CEOs 'wives are not like the "糟糠 妻"(long-suffering wives) of the past; their capabilities are often on par with their husbands, and they usually chose to focus on the family for the sake of their children. What’s more, Lori herself holds a significant amount of Nvidia stock, and there are even rumors that she played a key role in Jensen Huang’s return this time. According to news reports, Jensen Huang and Lori have reached an " understanding," which means the two have already reached a consensus regarding this crisis. Looking at Taiwan, the。stock market surged over 3,300 points today, with many stocks including TSMC hitting the daily limit, making them impossible to buy. But looking back, the Taiwan government has been busy. Despite activating the National Security Fund on November 6 and issuing three rounds of short-selling restrictions, the market still plummeted 17.5%last week. The Executive Yuan is now debating whether to expand the 500-billion-NTD fund, which has remained unchanged for 26 years. However, while the stock market has been.

in chaos, Taiwan's AI-related businesses seem largely unaffected. Even before Jensen Huang’s return, NVIDIA had been expanding its cooperation with the Taiwanese supply chain. Just last week, through cash investments and long-term contracts, they expanded capacity for substrates, advanced packaging, and foundry services to support AI infrastructure, with companies like TSMC and Foxconn among them. Moreover, only 11 days after "the Emperor returned to the palace," NVIDIA’s high-end roadmap for Blackwell. , Rubin, and Fireman remains unchanged. GPU iteration speeds will not slow down , and supply chain allocation will see no significant shifts, with orders secured through 2027 and some mass production reaching into 2028. As for the pace of U.S. AI development and U.S. -China relations, they still impact Taiwan. A senior executive in the semiconductor packaging and testing supply chain noted that while we must monitor if U.S. data center construction is slowing, the competition between the U.S. and China in AI computing power and national strength will only intensify. A senior economist at DBS Bank in Singapore warned that AI industry regulations might tighten after the U.S. midterm elections, especially since many planned data centers have not yet obtained construction or power permits, leaving future investment scales with significant variables. Le Monde also recently reported that TSMC alone accounts for about 40%of Taiwan's total market capitalization, and in the popular 0050 ETF, TSMC’s weighting exceeds half. So, this "Jensen Huang storm" serves as a wake-up call for.

Taiwan. When a personnel change at one American company can turn our stock market upside down, the government should ask: what if one day it isn't Huang who has a problem , but the entire AI industry fails to meet growth expectations? Does Taiwan have other economic engines to support us? I feel that while " Consort Huang" has returned to the palace, the drama is far from over, and now we must see how he plays his next moves. 婚禮拉贊助：年輕世代對抗高昂開銷的新趨勢

主持人范琪斐指出，過去影視作品中的植入廣告常為人詬病，但如今在中國年輕族群中，卻興起了一股向品牌尋求「婚禮贊助」的熱潮。一名沒有百萬追蹤的四川普通新娘「丹丹」，婚前向優酪乳品牌洽談贊助，成功讓現場300位賓客每人獲得一杯免費優酪乳，引發社群熱議。在社群平台小紅書上，「婚禮贊助」相關話題閱讀量已破千萬。這股趨勢背後的主因是婚禮開銷過於高昂，據調查中國平均婚禮費用超過160萬新台幣，相當於普通年輕人七年以上的可支配收入，但在經濟放緩與薪資成長緩慢的現狀下，長輩對排場的要求卻未降低，迫使新人發揮創意，若集齊各類贊助，最高可省下近9萬新台幣，相當於兩至三個月的薪水。

素人也能輕鬆獲取：品牌看中真實社交圈的傳播效益

要取得贊助的門檻其實並不高，新人只需透過社群平台向品牌遞交企劃，說明婚禮規模、賓客數與合作方式即可。品牌看重的並非新人的粉絲數量，而是婚禮的真實性以及產品能否自然亮相。一名僅有600位追蹤者的用戶便成功獲得5家品牌贊助，甚至有新人拿到多達20家品牌的物資支援。對品牌而言，傳統廣告容易被用戶滑過，但在婚宴上，親友會自發性拍照並發布限時動態，讓商品在真實社交圈中自然擴散，宣傳效益遠勝冰冷的廣告數據。隨著風潮蔓延，如「安慕希」與熱門零食品牌「辣王子」等更化被動為主動，主動招募新人並贊助特製道具，至今已贊助數千場婚禮。

省錢與質感的拉鋸：商業置入背後的隱憂與反思

儘管婚禮贊助能有效減輕荷包負擔，但並非所有新人都願意買單。有新人認為開口向廠商要東西顯得失禮，且為了幾千元贊助品需耗費大量時間與廠商溝通陳列、履約拍照回傳，反而加重備婚負擔；更有新娘為了完美展示贊助品，額外倒貼5000元新台幣購買裝飾物。此外，部分人擔憂過度商業化會稀釋婚禮本身的感動，甚至多年後翻看婚攝紀錄時只剩下滿滿的品牌商標。范琪斐總結表示，這類模式在台灣尚未普及，如何在新婚預算考量與一生一次的浪漫回憶之間取得平衡，依然取決於每對新人的價值選擇。
